outcome: mode of delivery (cesarean section, vaginal delivery)
cohort: The study included 100 pregnant women diagnosed with uterine fibroids via ultrasound.
finding: Uterine fibroids are associated with increased risks of adverse pregnancy outcomes, including higher rates of cesarean delivery and neonatal complications.
mod_finding: The cesarean section rate was high (65%) among pregnant women with uterine fibroids.
birth_weight: Measured as an outcome (low birth weight).
